title: Cod Flashes
description: have you ever wanted to play in a cod hell? this is the mod for you! it changes all entity models, block entities, and items to raw cod. on top of that, it renames every item in your inventory to raw cod! also you get cod flashbanged every interaction.
body:
default keybinds:
\ toggles all cod visuals together
[ toggles item cods
] toggles the flashbang 
; toggles cod block textures
' toggles cod entities

all keybinds are able to be changed in controls

enjoy codding!
